blocks.text: Simple pendulum mein ek chhota, bhari aur solid (thos) bob (mass m) hota hai jo ek rigid support (mazboot sahara) se halki aur inextensible (na khinchne wali) dori ke zariye latka hota hai.

Jab pendulum ko mean position O se kuch angle par extreme position P tak le ja kar chhora jaye to us par mean position ki taraf restoring force lagti hai. Is force ki wajah se pendulum gravity ke asar mein O ke gird ek curved (mure hue) raaste par aage peeche jhoolne lagta hai (Fig. 14.3-b).

blocks.alt: (a) Sahare se latakta simple pendulum mean position aur dono extreme positions par, doriyon aur mure raaste ke saath teer. (b) Bob extreme position P par, l lambai ki dori O se guzarti vertical line se angle theta banati. Tension T dori ke saath oopar; weight mg neeche, jo dori ke saath mg cos theta aur O ki taraf mg sin theta mein toota hai. O se P tak arc (qaus) S aur horizontal displacement x hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.3: Simple pendulum, (a) extreme positions ke darmiyan jhoolta aur (b) P par bob par forces (kitab ki Figure 14.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Extreme position P par bob ka weight (wazan) dori ki direction se angle θ banata hai. Weight ko do rectangular components mein torte hain. Pendulum dori ki direction mein motion nahi karta, is liye component mg cosθ aur dori ka tension T ek hi line par opposite directions mein hain aur ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain. Component mg sinθ mean position ki taraf restoring force deta hai aur yahi pendulum ko chalata hai:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab Fig. 14.3 ka sirf hissa (a), yani jhoolta pendulum, chhapti hai; hissa (b), jis ka text zikr karta hai, chhapa hi nahi. Is liye (b) text ke mutabiq banaya gaya hai. (b) mein dekhein: weight mg do components (hisson) mein toot-ta hai. Dori ke saath wala hissa mg cosθ tension T ke barabar ho kar khatam ho jata hai, aur dori par perpendicular (amood) hissa mg sinθ bob ko O ki taraf wapas kheenchta hai: yahi restoring force hai. Chhote angle par arc S aur x taqreeban barabar hain.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Har thartharati cheez awaz paida karti hai. Phir jhoolta simple pendulum awaz kyun paida nahi karta?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: jhoolta pendulum sunayi dene wali awaz kyun paida nahi karta?
blocks.explanation: Pendulum ki frequency bohat kam hai (second pendulum ki sirf 0.5 Hz). Insaan sirf taqreeban 20 Hz se 20 000 Hz tak ki awaz sun sakta hai, is liye pendulum se paida hone wali halki si hawa ki lehar sunayi nahi deti.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Agar pendulum Lahore se Karachi le jaya jaye to kya us ka time period badlega?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: Lahore se Karachi le jane par pendulum ka time period badlega?
blocks.explanation: Bohat thora sa. T = 2π√(ℓ/g) aur g jagah ke saath zara sa badalta hai: Karachi Lahore ke muqable mein Equator (Zameen ke beech ki lakeer) ke zyada qareeb hai, is liye wahan g thora kam hai aur T bohat thora lamba ho jata hai. Farq itna chhota hai ke aam stopwatch se maloom nahi hota, lekin pendulum ghari Karachi mein thori si slow (susti se) chalegi.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Lafz 'pendulum' Latin lafz 'pendulus' se bana hai, jis ka matlab hai 'latakta hua'.

Yeh formula batata hai ke simple pendulum ka time period dori ki lambai ke square root ke directly proportional aur g ke square root ke inversely proportional (ulat tanasub mein) hai. Time period bob ke mass m aur amplitude par depend nahi karta (chhote amplitude ke liye).
Jo pendulum ek vibration do second mein poori kare, yani jis ka time period 2 s ho, use second pendulum kehte hain.
